title: Ciena names Greg Friesen as EVP and chief product officer
summary: Ciena appoints Greg Friesen as Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer
detailed: Ciena appointed Greg Friesen as Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, reporting directly to President and CEO Gary Smith.
Friesen brings over 25 years of experience in product management, network design, and engineering, having previously served as Ciena's VP and General Manager of Global Services and Support.
In his new role, Friesen leads Ciena's global product organization, managing product line management, solutions engineering and introduction, and quality while collaborating with R&D.
Friesen holds an electrical engineering degree from the University of Saskatchewan and four granted patents in optical networking.
sentences: Ciena (NYSE: CIEN) announced the appointment of Greg Friesen as Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, effective today.
He reports to President and CEO Gary Smith and serves on the company’s Executive Leadership Team.

In this role, Friesen leads Ciena’s global product organization, with responsibility for product line management, solutions engineering and introduction (SE&I), and quality, working closely with the company’s R&D organization to advance Ciena’s product strategy.
Friesen has more than 25 years of experience across product management, network design, planning, and engineering.

Most recently, he served as Ciena’s Vice President and General Manager of Global Services and Support, with responsibility for customer support, deployment, training, managed services, and transformation capabilities.
He previously served as Vice President of Product Line Management, leading the development and introduction of several of Ciena’s market-leading optical networking platforms.

Before joining Ciena in 2017, Friesen served as Vice President of Product Management and Marketing at DragonWave and previously held product management and network planning roles at Innovance Networks and Nortel Networks.
